summary_en: FY2026 full-year dividend forecast raised to ¥80/share from ¥50/share. Interim dividend (Q2) and year-end dividend each increased to ¥40/share (from ¥25/share). Increase of ¥15/share at each distribution driven by upward revision of full-year operating profit and net income forecasts following strong H1 performance in semiconductor equipment.
title_en: Notice on difference between second quarter (interim period) consolidated earnings forecast and actual results for FY2026, revision of full-year consolidated earnings forecast, and revision (increase) of dividend forecast
translation_en_brief:
On 12 August 2026, CONVUM Ltd. filed a notice revising its FY2026 dividend forecast and full-year earnings guidance. The company raised its full-year dividend forecast to ¥80/share from the prior forecast of ¥50/share, comprising an interim (Q2) dividend of ¥40/share and a year-end dividend of ¥40/share. Each represents an increase of ¥15/share compared to the prior forecast (both prior distributions were ¥25/share).

The company also upwardly revised full-year net income to ¥284 million (¥185.68 per share) from ¥232 million (¥151.34 per share), driven by strong first-half results. H1 2026 orders for semiconductor manufacturing equipment surged on the back of recovering global semiconductor demand from AI-related investments, resulting in first-half net income of ¥187 million (¥122.99 per share), significantly ahead of the prior forecast of ¥125 million.

The company stated that dividend policy balances growth investment, financial soundness, and shareholder returns, with a basic principle of stable and continuous distributions. The increased dividend reflects the improved earnings outlook.
